claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a close-up with red text “EM81” on the machine body; no full view, no brand confirmation as “emel”, and no evidence of direct-drive or industrial classification.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (powers on, stitches correctly, feeds fabric properly).
risks.proof: A short test video: power on, threading, stitching a straight seam and a zigzag (if applicable), showing consistent feed and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/unknown working condition (worst case: may need service).

risks.risk: Missing essential parts (bobbin case/bobbins, foot pedal, power cable, presser foot/attachments).
risks.proof: A full layout photo/video showing all included items: power cable, foot pedal, bobbin case, bobbins, presser foot(s), and any included attachments.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts may be missing.

risks.risk: Needle area and feed mechanism condition (feed dogs, presser foot, needle bar alignment).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle plate area, feed dogs, and presser foot from multiple angles (and a stitching test showing smooth feeding).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/damaged in the needle/feed area.

risks.risk: Motor and speed control/foot pedal functionality (weak motor, faulty speed control).
risks.proof: Video showing foot pedal control from slow to fast while stitching, plus a brief sound/behavior check of the motor.
risks.if_unproven: Price as motor/speed control may be faulty.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in the close-up (cracks, bent parts, loose handwheel/cover, corrosion).
risks.proof: Full machine photos: front, side, back, and underside (where safe), plus close-ups of any seams/joints and the handwheel/cover area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible cosmetic/structural wear beyond the close-up.

proof_requests: Send a full photo of the entire sewing machine (front/side/back) including the needle area and presser foot.
Send a photo/video of the machine powered on with a short stitching test (straight seam and, if possible, zigzag).
Show all included accessories: foot pedal, power cable, bobbin case, bobbins, needles, and any presser feet/attachments.
Provide close-ups of the needle plate/feed dogs and presser foot from straight-on angles.
Show speed control/foot pedal response in a short video while stitching.
response.reason: The witness can identify the marking “EM81”, but the key factors that determine value in Abuja (working condition, missing parts, motor/pedal function, and accessory set) are not shown. Without at least a test run and included-parts proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
